theme: An open Sunday between two short calls.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. A quiet Sunday in St. Pete with the girls: fifteen minutes with Mike to start, the island associations' annual meeting at five, and a wide-open middle in between.

needsAttention.title: Mark needs your vote or a proxy
needsAttention.detail: Mark Hoffman asked yesterday whether you're joining today's 5 PM annual meeting; you've accepted the invite but haven't told him, and he's counting votes. A one-line reply settles it.

needsAttention.title: Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The full-size Portland SUV for the girls' Maine Christmas, flagged 'book this week' back on Sept 14, is the board's top-priority item, and holiday inventory only thins from here. A refundable hold costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: December break still undecided
needsAttention.detail: The three-week holiday trip for six was meant to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15; both dates have passed, and holiday inventory is the thinnest of the year.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15 min on Meet; empty the board inbox, put an owner and date on everything

schedule.title: DIRA & DIBA Annual Meeting
schedule.detail: Annual Bridge & Road Association meeting on Zoom; materials in your inbox since Oct 2

flagged.title: Burson SVP, Corporate & Public Affairs
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged a WPP/Burson senior public-affairs opening, with four of your former colleagues there.

flagged.title: ICGN board dinner in Toronto
flagged.detail: ICGN invited you to its board dinner Nov 3, the evening before the conference; it's awaiting your RSVP.

flagged.title: Venmo request, $50
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for mowing on 10/14.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions: language lessons, travel fares, catalogs, and shipping notices.

resolved.title: ICGN Plenary 7 planning call wrapped
resolved.detail: Thursday's planning call for your conference plenary is done; Claudia circulated the delegate companies and titles afterward.

recipe.title: Braised Pheasant with Mushrooms and Bacon
recipe.why: A slow autumn braise for the season of game, wild mushrooms, and the first cold evenings.

Drive the Pathfinder down to St Pete

acts.line: The weekly review with Mike opens the day: fifteen minutes to clear the board inbox and put an owner and date on everything.
Nothing on the calendar across the whole middle of the day, an open Sunday stretch to spend as you choose.
The DIRA & DIBA annual meeting closes the day on Zoom; the materials have sat in your inbox since October 2.
